context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 testing completed successfully. Key features verified: 1) Profit Leakage Alert System at /dashboard/alerts with 7 alert types (low_margin, underpriced_quote, payment_delay, project_delay, material_variance, excess_material, team_inefficiency), risk scoring 0-100, configurable thresholds. 2) Alert Dashboard shows 4 KPIs (Total Leakage, Active Alerts, Risky Projects, Alert Types), Leakage by Category chart, Risk Distribution, High-Risk Projects table. 3) Thresholds API (GET/PUT /api/settings/thresholds) for min_margin_pct, max_material_variance_pct, payment_delay_days, max_project_duration_days. 4) Consolidated 8 reports: sales_revenue, profit_leakage, project_execution, inventory_material, customer_credit, team_performance, compliance_tax, customer_satisfaction. 5) Tab-based views: sales_revenue (overview, lead_sources), profit_leakage (profit, material_variance), inventory_material (stock_levels, material_usage, alerts). 6) Old report types (sales, profit, expense, inventory, execution) return 404. 7) Enhanced filters: date_from, date_to, system_type, status, customer, staff. 8) Charts use CSS bar visualizations instead of Recharts Pie (Recharts v3 Cell had ref issues).
